summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans two complementary layers: model repositories like Hugging Face that host and distribute weights, and developer-facing inference platforms like Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow that make running those models fast and accessible via APIs or local runtimes. As of 2026, Hugging Face has surpassed 3 million public models, with download activity now led by Chinese labs (Moonshot, MiniMax, DeepSeek, Qwen) alongside U.S. players, though a tiny fraction of models account for nearly half of all downloads. Inference platforms differentiate on speed, pricing, model breadth, and whether they target local, serverless, or enterprise-scale deployment.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository and community hub for hosting, sharing, and discovering AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), with an accompanying serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints.
platforms.model_count: 3M+ public models (crossed 3 million in August 2026; ~747K added in 2026 YTD)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public hosting and limited inference; Pro subscription (~$9/mo); pay-as-you-go Inference Endpoints billed by compute/hour; Enterprise Hub plans
features: Largest open model and dataset registry
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Spaces for hosting ML demos and apps
Model cards, versioning, and git-based repos
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers needing the broadest selection of open models, datasets, and collaboration tooling

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A tool for running open LLMs locally on your own machine with a simple CLI and local API, bundling model weights, config, and runtime.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, and variants)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; no usage fees since models run on local hardware
features: One-command local model download and run
Local REST API compatible with OpenAI format
Quantized GGUF model support for consumer hardware
Modelfile customization for prompts and parameters
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users wanting to run LLMs locally without cloud costs or data sharing

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform to run and deploy open-source models (especially image, video, audio, and LLMs) via simple API calls, with easy packaging of custom models using Cog.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models across modalities
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU usage); no subscription required
features: Run models via a single API call
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Strong support for image/video/audio generation models
Automatic scaling to zero when idle
Public model gallery with versioned models
platforms.best_for: App developers and startups wanting quick API access to multimodal models without managing infrastructure

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A developer cloud offering fast, scalable inference and fine-tuning for a wide range of open-source LLMs, plus training infrastructure and GPU clusters.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (per 1M tokens, tiered by model size); GPU cluster and fine-tuning billed separately
features: Support for the latest open frontier models
platforms.best_for: Developers and companies building production apps on open models needing speed, scale, and fine-tuning

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A performance-focused inference platform delivering low-latency, high-throughput serving of open LLMs and multimodal models for production workloads.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom model deployment
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; on-demand dedicated GPU deployments billed hourly
features: Function calling and structured JSON output
platforms.best_for: Production teams prioritizing low latency and cost-efficient high-volume inference on open models

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer inference platform (strong in Asia/China) providing fast, affordable API access to a broad catalog of open models including leading Chinese LLMs and image/video models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ models including DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kolors, and other Chinese and global open models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token/usage with competitive low pricing; free credits for new users on select models
features: Optimized serving for Chinese open-source models
Text, image, video, and audio model support
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) wanting cheap, fast access to leading Chinese and global open models

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An inference platform built on custom LPU hardware delivering extremely low-latency token generation for open LLMs via API.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mixtral, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token, priced competitively per 1M tokens; free developer tier available
features: LPU hardware for industry-leading inference speed
Very low latency for real-time applications
Curated selection of popular open models
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-sensitive, real-time AI applications on open models

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway that routes requests across many model providers (open and closed), letting developers access hundreds of models through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models aggregated from dozens of providers
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use passthrough pricing per model plus a small platform fee; prepaid credits
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Access to both open and proprietary models
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting flexible multi-provider access and cost/performance optimization without managing many integrations
